message.content:
This vertical cover illustration for Tempo magazine, dated "EDISI 22-28 OKTOBER 2012," features a large blue rectangular area containing the text "REBUTAN EMAS DI BANYUWANGI" and "SURYA PALOH ★ EDWIN SOERYADJAYA." 

The lower portion shows a dry, rocky landscape under a light-blue sky. Two men, rendered in a caricatured style, stand in the foreground. On the left, a bearded man wearing a brown wide-brimmed hat and a blue plaid shirt pulls on one side of a black metal pan. On the right, a gray-haired man in a red shirt with suspenders pulls on the other side. Both men are smiling with open mouths, showing teeth. The pan between them contains water and several golden-colored, irregularly shaped lumps. 

Behind them, a wooden sluice box channels water into the foreground. A gray donkey stands on a rocky ledge in the mid-ground, looking toward the viewer. The terrain consists of light-brown boulders and dry soil. Small green bushes grow on a distant ridge. At the top, the text "REKAYASA KASUS PENYIDIK NOVEL TERKUAK" appears above the large red "TEMPO" masthead. A barcode and "RP 29.700" are in the bottom-left corner.
